evidence.section: SOK to Splunk Enterprise version compatibility; Upgrade path guidance
evidence.statement: The SOK 3.2 Help matrix lists 3.2.0 on September 24, Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 and Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. The September 8 changelog lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. The matrix directs upgrading SOK first; the release changelog scopes the queue reference change to Index and Ingestion Separation.
